about: On the party entity: PartyUuid, Views (one for each user, each with its Characters) and Characters, every character of the party view. A character present in both lists is an anchor of activation: the space around it is awake. Script Extender: PartyView.

evidence.says: Script Extender declares eoc::party::ViewComponent::PartyUuid at +0x0 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Party.h:14): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types; the computed offset equals the one in its earlier name. Not checked against the game's code.

Script Extender declares eoc::party::ViewComponent::Views at +0x10 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Party.h:14): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code.

Script Extender declares eoc::party::ViewComponent::Characters at +0x20 (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Party.h:14): its author's name and type; the offset is computed from the declared types. Not checked against the game's code.
the game's executable keeps this type name among its ECS type names (gatekit symbols types)
on the level Basic_Level_A the party entity named by PartyMember.Party of the host carries it with one view of one character, the host, and a PartyUuid

reported from the study of the camera focus, not read again here: a spawned character given PartyMember and appended to both lists wakes every character within 40 m on the next tick, and taking it out puts them to sleep

survey.from: Script Extender's declarations (BG3Extender/GameDefinitions/Components/Party.h:14, kind component), by gatekit symbols se-layouts on 2026-11-14
survey.names: Every name here is Script Extender's author's (his headers), not the game's own: they are kept because they are what the extender's Lua answers to and what bg3_verify compares, and every field carries the rung `extender` - the extender's name for the field at that offset, which nobody has checked against the game's code. A name is raised from `extender` only with evidence from the code, by `gatekit names set`.
